name: Can fire extinguisher powder cause damage to my property?

mainEntity.name: Can fire extinguisher powder cause damage to my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, fire extinguisher powder can cause significant damage to property beyond the initial fire incident. The chemicals in the powder are corrosive and can etch surfaces, stain fabrics, and degrade electronics over time if not removed promptly and correctly. Its fine particles can also penetrate HVAC systems, spreading contamination throughout a building. Professional cleanup is crucial to mitigate long-term damage and restore your property effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fire extinguisher powder is corrosive and can damage surfaces, electronics, and fabrics, causing etching, staining, and degradation if not cleaned promptly.
